description: AI-synthesized climate risk report — TCFD physical risk assessment, commodity stress signals across 11 markets, climate outlook (STABLE/ELEVATED/CRITICAL), and narrative risk guidance. Sourced from DPX Commodity Forecast Oracle and live climate signals. Cached hourly. Requires a pre-purchased DPX Reports API key via Authorization: Bearer <key>.

apiKey.description: DPX Reports API key. Alternatively, set Authorization: Bearer <key> in the calling context.

name: reports.climate
